title: Choose Lean — round 2
question: Horizon, Needle, and Twin are out. Three new structures in the same HUD world. Still: glance lean, steer percent while riding, no toy bike.

options.label: Tape
options.thesis: A rolling bank tape in a window, like an aircraft scale — the number sits still, the ticks move.
options.viewport: Portrait plaque. Left third is a vertical window of ticks (15/30/45) scrolled so 32 sits at a fixed orange bug. Right: huge still 32°. Steer hairline along the bottom.
options.risk: Aviation grammar may not read as moto at a glance.

options.label: Lights
options.thesis: Lean as the Dash rev lights: a row of capsules lighting out from center. Hardware, not a drawing of a bike.
options.viewport: Wide plaque. Huge orange 32° on top. One row of 11 rounded LED cells, center white, four to the right lit orange. A thinner second row is steer at 30%. Dim L and R on the ends.
options.risk: Can look like a second RPM bar sitting near Dash.

options.label: Shear
options.thesis: The number is the widget. The +32° ExtraBold Italic is sheared with the bike; steer is a caption. No gauge chrome.
options.viewport: Compact plaque. One huge sheared orange +32° filling the field. Small white 30% R under it. No arc, no needle, no columns, no LEDs.
options.risk: If the shear is timid it is just a big number; if loud it can look like a title plaque.
